    1: """S84 W10a Gate 118 — VII.K-PROP atlas SHA uniqueness audit.
    2: 
    3: Tests the pre-registered hypothesis (§W10a-118):
    4:     All verdict SHAs in the §VII.K-PROP propagation atlas are pairwise
    5:     distinct AND each traces to an independent pin map (no two verdicts
    6:     share the same canonical input-pin sequence).
    7: 
    8: Schema note: the atlas (s84_w3_vii_k_prop_atlas.json) does NOT carry a
    9: per-row `closure_sha256` or `input_pin_ordered_list` field. Its
   10: provenance is one meta-level closure_sha plus per-row content
   11: (p_k, class, span_predicted, provenance, classification). For the
   12: distinctness audit we therefore compute a per-row content SHA from
   13: the canonical JSON of (p_k, class, span_predicted, provenance) and a
   14: per-row pin-map proxy from the same tuple.
   15: 
   16: Pass / Fail / INFO thresholds (from plan §W10a-118):
   17:     PASS: All SHAs pairwise distinct AND all pin-maps mutually
   18:           independent (<80% positional overlap).
   19:     FAIL: Any SHA collision OR any two pin-maps with >=80% positional
   20:           overlap.
   21:     INFO: All distinct but pin-maps cluster.
   22: 
   23: Verdict-line format (S81+ canonical):
   24:     S84-VII-K-PROP-SHA-UNIQUENESS: PASS|FAIL|INFO -- value=<distinct/total>
   25:         scheme=pairwise_sha_plus_pin_map convention=vii_k_prop_atlas_full
   26:         L_max=N/A audit_sha256=<64-char> content_sha256=<64-char>
   27: """

   29: 
   30: import datetime

    2: """
    3: S84-W10b-123: ALPHA-S-DERIVATION-CHAIN-AUDIT
    4: ================================================================================
    5: 
    6: Gate: S84-ALPHA-S-DERIVATION-CHAIN-AUDIT
    7: Trigger: [VERIFY-THEOREM]
    8: Classification: GEOMETRIC
    9:

   11:   S50's permanent identity alpha_s = n_s^2 - 1 derives from the minimal axiom
   12:   set {CCM 2007 A1-A6 + KO-dim=6 + A_F = C (+) H (+) M_3(C) singleton +
   13:   Mellin-kernel spectral action}, WITHOUT auxiliary coupling relations and
   14:   WITHOUT observational n_s as input.
   15: 
   16: Method (per plan §W10b-123):
   17:   Step 1: formalize the axiom set
   18:   Step 2: trace the S50 derivation chain (sourced from s50_running_mass.py
   19:           Sections 6/8/9, atlas T15 entry, session-50-results-workingpaper.md)
   20:   Step 3: classify each step as
   21:             CCM_2007_A1_A6 / KO_dim=6 / A_F_singleton / Mellin_kernel
   22:             OR auxiliary OR observational
   23:   Step 4: count auxiliaries and observational n_s usage
   24:   Step 5: run cross-checks
   25:             (a) Mellin-kernel closure: verify d^2(ln P)/d(ln k)^2 = alpha_s
   26:                 (the second-derivative interpretation, sympy)
   27:             (b) substrate-level alpha_s match -0.068968 to <=1% via the
   28:                 exact O-Z formula alpha_s = -4u/(1+u)^2 evaluated at u
   29:                 solved from n_s = 0.9649 (since u = (1+n_s)/(1-n_s) for
   30:                 constant mass)
